patch_description:
The seed uses six occupancy categories, prior strength 12, cumulative updates, risk weight 45, and a fixed waiting threshold of .12. This replacement infers attempted movement laws from anonymous occupancy transitions, including blocked attempts. It combines uniform, slow-learning, and fast-learning models with evidence-based weights; evidence retention is .985 and .86 per step.
Control uses equal movement-time costs, persistent exploration targets, and three-step planning with explicit collision-before-movement and collision-after-movement risk. Immediate risk weight is 100, with future weights .55 and .25. Mapping remains separate from predictive learning and prediction-use interventions. These changes target safer, faster escapes; improvement requires evaluation.
